description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting Coveted Jewel.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Voltaic Key's ability, targeting Voltaic Key.
Resolve both Voltaic Key abilities, untapping it and Coveted Jewel.
Repeat.

uses.name: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment
